mapper.select: SELECT id, name, short_name, level, color, sort_no, enabled, created_at, updated_at FROM rk_subject ORDER BY sort_no ASC, id ASC
SELECT id, name, short_name, level, color, sort_no, enabled, created_at, updated_at FROM rk_subject WHERE enabled = 1 ORDER BY sort_no ASC, id ASC
SELECT id, name, short_name, level, color, sort_no, enabled, created_at, updated_at FROM rk_subject WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rk_subject (id, name, short_name, level, color, sort_no, enabled) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{shortName}, #{level}, #{color}, #{sortNo}, #{enabled})
mapper.update: UPDATE rk_subject SET name = #{name}, short_name = #{shortName}, level = #{level}, color = #{color}, sort_no = #{sortNo}, enabled = #{enabled}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
